Container.Name: profit-monitor
Container.Overview: Profit Monitor for Pokémon TCG trading. Self-hosted: all tabs, transactions and trades are stored as one JSON file in the appdata folder, with a daily backup.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port on your Unraid server where the app opens (http://UNRAID-IP:port).

Config.Name: Data folder
Config.Description: Where your data is stored on the server: profit-monitor.json plus a backups folder.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Used for the dates in backup file names.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Owner of the data files (99 = nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group of the data files (100 = users on Unraid).

Config.Name: Backups to keep
Config.Description: Number of daily backups kept in the backups folder.

Config.Name: Login user (optional)
Config.Description: Set together with the password to require a login. Leave both empty for no login.
